web.description:
# Escrow Payment Solutions: Complete Guide 2026
## Top Escrow Payment Providers in 2026
### 1. Escrow.com: Best for high-value goods and domain transactions
[Escrow.com](https://www.escrow.com/) is licensed, bonded, and regularly audited by government agencies in California, with no chargebacks ever on any transaction [.](https://www.escrow.com/) It is the dominant provider for domain name sales (having handled uber.com, instagram.com, and twitter.com) and serves vehicles, luxury goods, IPv4 addresses, and high-value merchandise.

Its API integrates into existing platforms. Best suited for marketplaces handling single high-value items rather than high-volume low-value transactions.

### 4. Tazapay: Best for cross-border B2B trade
[Tazapay](https://slashdot.org/software/online-escrow/) holds buyer funds until shipment is confirmed and provides full refunds for delayed shipments, with compliance handled including KYC, KYB, and shipping document verification.

It is designed for international B2B trade where currency risk, customs, and logistics uncertainty create the trust problem that escrow solves. It supports multiple currencies and handles the regulatory complexity of cross-border fund holding across jurisdictions.

### 5. Trustap: Best for C2C and used-goods marketplaces
Trustap integrates with Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom platforms via API, offering end-to-end payments, automated fulfillment tracking, and dispute support in an escrow-style flow that builds user trust. It partners with Stripe for underlying payment security and is specifically designed for the vehicle and domain markets alongside general C2C use cases.

### 6. J.P. Morgan Escrow Services: Best for M&A and corporate transactions
[J.P. Morgan's](https://www.jpmorgan.com/payments/solutions/escrow-services) Escrow Direct platform manages closing agent escrows, paying agent services, litigation escrows, and capital-raising escrows across global markets, with real-time tracking and a dedicated service team for complex multi-party deals.

web.title: Trustap lets strangers transact with confidence - Stripe
web.description:
![](https://stripe.com/newsroom/stories/trustap-and-stripe)![](https://stripe.com/newsroom/stories/trustap-and-stripe)

Trustap lets strangers transact with confidence

![Trustap logo lockup - Trustap logo lockup](https://images.stripeassets.com/fzn2n1nzq965/2hV6vpo1c8SYAfoQzWOXUz/f5ed3639e716b4f0a136b8738e301aea/Trustap-_Newsroom_4000x2000__3_.png?w=4000&q=80)

After being swindled once too often, Conor Lyden decided to do something about it, so he created [Trustap](https://www.trustap.com/), a safer way to buy and sell with people or businesses you don’t know.

Trustap is an escrow-style platform that eliminates the risk of being scammed when transacting online or in person.

Founded in 2017 through the [IGNITE](https://www.ucc.ie/en/ignite/aboutus/) start-up incubator program at Ireland’s University College Cork, Trustap now operates in more than 130 countries.

Trustap will use the [Stripe Payment Element](https://stripe.com/blog/introducing-the-payment-element) to offer popular Malaysian payment methods such as Financial Process Exchange, recognizing that while trust is a universal good, establishing it requires attention to local customs.
